Team —

I ran the security questionnaire with our InfoSec team. See attached: security_qs_responses.docx. High-level blockers flagged:
- Data residency: our policy requires the test dataset to remain in our EU region unless explicit exception is granted (we will need to confirm whether sandbox can be pinned).
- Audit logs: we need a sample of retention and log extraction process for review (Carlos to coordinate with Redwood).
- Encryption-at-rest: currently noted as a question on the questionnaire — can you confirm KMS options?

Given these, acceptance gate A2 (security signoff) may slip until we have confirmation on data residency and log export. We still want to proceed with functional tests in parallel.

Carlos
